news.text: #Juve, Nico Says YesOk from #Spalletti#González signs until 2030[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]
#Nico-#Juve Until 2030From outcast to key playerThere is an agreement to extend for one season[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE BETS ON NICOFrom a mercato pawn to a technical and moral leader: today #González renews until 2030, driven by the decisive push of #Spalletti.The Argentine, who immediately became a key locker room figure, is making up for the difficulties of #Kolo and #Woltemade: agreement with the entourage, awaiting the signature. Also in the bianconero plans, new contacts for #DouglasLuiz, #Kalulu and #Conceição. Capital increase: the projects for the Stadium and the J-Medical. Sunday against #Cagliari: #Alajbegović, fatigue alert.[Front Page TuttoSport]
#NicoGonzalez is one step away to sign the contract extension with #Juventus until 2030. Expected the signing this month. #transfers[Nico Schira]
#Juve renewals✅ Nico #González 🔜 Francisco #Conceição, Pierre #Kalulu[Mirko Di Natale]
‼️Nico #Gonzalez stays at #Juve: a contract renewal is arriving in the coming days (@demichelis90).[Mirko Di Natale]
#Boga performed individualized training on the pitch.[Marco Baridon]

AT LA CONTINASSA 📍 Juan #Cabal is back in group training#NicoGonzalez has also returned from his international duties with Argentina (and is very close to a contract renewal). @junews24com[Marco Baridon]

🇫🇷🧠 #KoloMuani has re-watched all of his matches with #Juventus to analyze his own movements and understand where to improve. #Spalletti is working to make him sharper and closer to the goal, also evaluating his coexistence with #Woltemade. The Frenchman continues to work incredibly hard: he carefully manages his diet and rest, he often trains beyond the scheduled program, he is among the first to arrive and the last to leave.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🎯🔛 #Juventus, pushed by #Carnevali, wants #Bakola: the idea is to move in advance to avoid competition. First contacts with #Sassuolo have already taken place, an attempt could be made in January, but the neroverdi would not have the intention to sell him. The alternative is to find a privileged position for the summer. The plan is to secure both him and #Hojbjerg: one as a future investment and the other as a more immediate reinforcement.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
